'''Vilardo Kaine''' was a moderately successful [[Merchant/Legends|trader]] and unapologetic [[Speciesism|speciesist]] living on [[Bastion/Legends|Sartinaynian]]. He was the father of the [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Ardus Kaine]]. Foisting all his aspirations on his son, he insisted it was his boy's duty to reach the highest echelon of galactic power. He was killed in a [[pirate]] attack that had pushed his son to wholeheartedly support [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] philosophy.
